Fake xcrun and maestro for the capture-app, run-parity and setup-parity-sim self-tests. Each fixture folder holds a scenario.json the fakes read from the working directory. The fake xcrun writes each launch's nonce (from the -parity query) to $FAKE_PARITY_STATE, and the fake maestro adds the marker parity.launch.<nonce> to the dump it prints, as the app's parity root does; scenario.omitNonce leaves it out, and scenario.requireArgs (for example --device <udid> --driver-host-port 22187) makes any other call get scenario.otherSession, another simulator's screen without the marker.
